events.title: God, Save the Queens! Is Coming to Steam Deck™
events.summary: God, Save the Queens! is now nearly fully supported on Steam Deck™! After fixing countless bugs and overcoming the challenges of porting the game to a handheld console, God, Save the Queens! is now nearly fully supported on Steam Deck™. From now on, the game will receive updates for both Windows and SteamOS / Linux. events.title: Curse Rewards + Improved Collectible Statistics - 1.0.210 Update
events.summary: New Features:Improved the Curse Level system. You now receive powerful rewards when starting a run at higher Curse Levels. New modifiers have also been added.The Collectibles menu now shows detailed statistics, including weapon stats, skill and consumable descriptions, as well as enemy health, movement speed, damage, and short descriptions.

events.title: New weapon effect & Improved performance - 1.0.205 Update
events.summary: Changes Damage numbers now use TextMeshPro 3D instead of rendering individual canvases for each damage popup, reducing lag spikes during intense battles. Added a 0.25-second cooldown for blood spawning on hit to improve performance. Minor bug fixes and balance adjustments. New Features Added Knockback weapon effect. Added a DPS (Damage Per Second) Counter, which can be enabled in the Settings menu. Added 12 new blood splash variations. Added a new Curse Level Intro from Curse Level 2.

events.title: New Enemy Attacks & Minibosses - 1.0.201 Update
events.summary: +9 enemies received new attack patterns: Ember Warden (3rd empire) Forest Spirit (4th empire) Spore Gunner (4th empire) Forest Gnome (4th empire) Ancient Talon (4th empire) Captain Skeleton (4th empire) Mini Golem (4th empire) Void Serpent (5th empire) Reaper (5th empire) +3 enemies received additional attack patterns when spawning as minibosses: Ember Warden Captain Skeleton Reaper Other Changes: New portal entry effect added. Improved the Community Stats UI.

events.title: New Features / Fixes | 1.0.198 Update
events.summary: New Features / Changes: The starter weapon is now randomly selected from three possible weapons at the start of each run: Wooden Boomerang, Spear, or Sickle. Improved the Community Stats UI and loading speed. Fixed an issue with the Mutation effect in the fourth empire. You will no longer receive new weapon upgrades from empires that are two tiers behind your current empire. (For example, if you are in the 5th empire, you can only receive weapons from the 4th and 5th empires.) Reduced the Bombar

events.title: Community Stats on the Godboards | 1.0.195 Update
events.summary: We added a new menu to the Godboards where you can view aggregated community statistics, such as total kills, total waves completed, total playtime, and more.Currently, there are three statistic categories: all-time, monthly, and daily.(Modded runs do not contribute to community statistics!)

events.title: Minor improvements | 1.0.194 Update
events.summary: New Features: The Eternal God Mode will activate before death. Life Bloom now restores more HP/second. New tutorial popups for certain skills. Fixed a bug related to the spawning of enemies. Fixed additional minor issues.

events.title: New Enemies, Features - 1.0.189 Update
events.summary: New Enemies: Mummy (Vokar Empire) Thorn Bandit (Vokar Empire) Nyxara (Vokar Empire) Skeleton Wagon (Miniboss) (Vokar Empire)New Weapon: Pulse Bow (Multishot IV). Changes:Normal Bow now has the Multishot III effect. New Wave Type: MINI BOSS FIGHTThis type of wave has 25% chance to occur once you are halfway to the next queen.The goal is to defeat the mini boss which is a heavily buffed enemy.Currently only the Shadowguard Officer and the Skeleton Wagon can spawn as a mini boss.

events.title: Bug fixes - 1.0.185 Update
events.summary: New Features / Bug Fixes: Fixed two game-breaking bugs affecting the tile save system. Fixed an issue that caused incorrect critical damage chance calculations for weapons. Improved weapon collision performance. Enemy totems are now available in the collectibles menu. Skeletons in the Vokar Empire now have a chance to throw bones at the player. The Reroll queen effect now grants only 1 reroll/rewards.

events.title: New Weapon Special Effects - 1.0.184 Update
events.summary: New Weapon Special Effects: Multishot - Fires multiple projectiles simultaneously. Fragmentation - Projectiles break apart into smaller pieces after traveling for a short time. New Weapons Added: Bow Ice Wand (comes with Multishot) Magic Wand (comes with Fragmentation)

events.title: Frost Effect / Ice Weapons - 1.0.182 Update
events.summary: New Features: Quickshot consumable: Reduces reload time by 50% for 9 seconds. Life Bloom skill: Creates an area around the player that heals nearby allies, including queens. Added a new special effect for weapons: Frost Effect: x% chance to freeze enemies for x seconds.Added two unique weapons that have Frost Effect: Ice Daggers, Frostaxe.

events.title: Small Update - v1.0.181
events.summary: New Features / Fixes: Allies are brought to the following empire with you after entering the portal. Fixed an issue with the Chain Strike skill. Changed the base chance of level up rewards: Max Health - 30% | Weapon Slot - 20% | Skill Slot - 35% | Consumable Slot: 15%

events.title: New: Cursor Accessibility - 1.0.178
events.summary: 1.0.178 Update:Changing cursor/pointer size is now available in the Settings menu.+4 cursor/pointer textures can be selected for the cursor with the option to use the system's default cursor.Confined Cursor Option: Prevents the cursor/pointer from leaving the game window.

events.title: God, Save the Queens! After 1 Year of Development!
events.summary: "God, Save the Queens!" is a 2.5D wave-based Rogue-like where you are God who came down to rescue Arthur III, the King of Provia's five daughters from the evil empires. Kill thousands of enemies, upgrade your skills, unlock new weapons, and save the queens!
